title: Home
description: An overview of FastAPI, its key features, performance benchmarks, and a simple getting-started example.

title: Tutorials - User Guide
description: Step-by-step guides to learn the core concepts of FastAPI from the ground up, from basics to advanced patterns.

title: First Steps
description: Learn how to install FastAPI and create your first simple 'Hello World' application.

title: Path and Query Parameters
description: Understand how to declare, validate, and document parameters from the URL path and query string.

title: Request Body
description: Explore how to receive, validate, and process JSON data and form data sent in the request body using Pydantic models.

title: Dependencies and Security
description: Master FastAPI's powerful Dependency Injection system and implement authentication and authorization, including HTTP Basic, OAuth2, and API Keys.

title: Advanced User Guide
description: Dive deeper into advanced features like WebSockets, middleware, bigger application structures, and database integrations.

title: WebSockets
description: Implement real-time, bidirectional communication with clients using WebSockets.

title: Bigger Applications
description: Structure your growing application using APIRouters to split your API into multiple files and modules.

title: Middleware
description: Learn how to add custom middleware for processing requests and responses, including CORS, GZip, and more.

title: SQL Databases
description: Connect your FastAPI application to SQL databases using libraries like SQLModel, including examples for CRUD operations.

title: Testing
description: Write tests for your FastAPI application, including testing dependencies with overrides, using the TestClient.

title: API Reference
description: A comprehensive, searchable reference for all of FastAPI's classes, functions, and utilities.

title: FastAPI Class
description: Detailed documentation for the main `FastAPI` application class, its parameters, and configuration options.

title: APIRouter
description: Reference for the `APIRouter`, used to structure your application into multiple modules and files.

title: Parameters
description: In-depth reference for `Path`, `Query`, `Header`, `Cookie`, `Body`, `Form`, and `File` parameter functions.

title: Dependencies
description: Complete guide to the dependency injection system, including `Depends` and `Security`.

title: Security
description: Reference for all security utilities, including `OAuth2PasswordBearer`, `HTTPBasic`, `APIKeyHeader`, and more.

title: Responses
description: Details on `Response` classes like `JSONResponse`, `HTMLResponse`, `StreamingResponse`, and how to customize them.

title: Exceptions
description: Documentation for `HTTPException`, `WebSocketException`, and related exception handlers.

title: Contributing
description: Learn how you can contribute to the FastAPI project, report issues, and understand the development process.

title: Security Policy
description: Information on how to report security vulnerabilities and details about supported versions.
